question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the given idiom.

Everybody said that Mr. Sen was a man of _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**letters**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**a man of letters**" refers to someone who is well-versed in literature or scholarly pursuits.
 
• The word "**letters**" in this context symbolizes literary or academic knowledge.
 
• The other options: "**books**," "**messages**," and "**copies**" do not fit the idiomatic expression correctly.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Everybody said that Mr. Sen was a man of letters__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Books**: While related to literature, it does not complete the idiom "a man of letters."
 
• **Messages**: This refers to communication and is unrelated to the idiomatic context.
 
• **Copies**: Refers to duplicates and has no connection to the idiom.
